rows.en: Pathetic... There's no need for me to dirty my own hands.
It's you... It's because of you... The sky... the sky is falling!!
The O! Did you put enhancements on Bound Doc...?
The O! Did you enhance Bound Doc...?
The O! What kind of research are you doing here...?
The O! What kind of research are you doing here...?
The O! You... Your own comrades...?
The O! You... Your own comrades...?
The O! What the hell do you think your comrades are!!
The O! What the hell did you do to your comrades!!
The O! What the hell did you do to your comrades!!
...Yes, that's it. Perhaps I'll test the "Super Soldier" as well.
Tieren Taozi! This is your first sortie. Dispose of these people!
This is your first sortie. Dispose of these people.
Sir!! As a Super Soldier, I will complete this mission without fail!!
Super Soldier... I implanted her quantum brainwaves. That too is a kind of enhancement...
I've seen many unknown worlds' technologies here, yet human sin is the same in every world.
Go! Bound Doc! Tieren Taozi! Prove the true strength of enhanced soldiers!!
...Lord The O will soon have the King Stone in hand...
And when that happens... the likes of you...
Don't tell me he's after the King Stone!!
Don't tell me he's after the King Stone!!
Don't tell me he's after the King Stone!!
Don't tell me he's after the King Stone!!
Don't tell me he's after the King Stone!!
Don't tell me he's after the King Stone!!
Ah! That bastard's going after the King Stone!!
Don't tell me he's after the King Stone!!

notes.note: Scirocco's signature line (falling crane flies/gnats) rendered 'Fall!! You pack of gnats!!'.
#0.35-0.42 and #0.45-0.52 are party-leader variants (identical source); same English as Zero's line. 'He' = The O (g=m).
Bound Doc (g=n) speaks with its pilot's 'the sky is falling' obsession; addressed at the party leader. No pronouns used for it.
Source spells the name with 'Dog' in dialogue; glossary spelling 'Bound Doc' used. 'Kyouka' (enhanced, as in enhanced humans) rendered 'enhance/enhancement' throughout (#0.58-59, #0.71, #0.73).

#0.59-0.66 are leader variants of #0.58. #0.62-63 deliberately trail off. #0.64 is the rough-spoken leader (same slot as the rough variant in #0.29 and #0.107). 'Nakama' = The O's own people, rendered 'comrades'.
'Chouhei' (00 term) = 'Super Soldier', capitalised as a title; Tieren Taozi = Soma Peries (g=f).
Unlabelled variant of #0.68 without the name; The O speaking.
'Her' = Tieren Taozi (glossary g=f). 'Nouryoushiha' = quantum brainwaves, as in story_037. 'Given after birth' (koutenteki) carried as 'implanted'; 'so to speak' dropped to fit.
'Hito no gou' (human karma/sinfulness) rendered 'human sin'; 'came into contact with' compressed to 'seen' to fit the box.
System message; 'storehouse' matches story_031/033 for the same place.
Honorific '-sama' on The O carried as 'Lord The O'. 'King Stone' (Black RX term) not in glossary.

#0.81-0.114 are leader-variant blocks of four (Wait / Ankh: The O's gone / King Stone / He's gone to RX); identical source given identical English. #0.83 restores 'he's after' for the dropped verb. #0.84 'RX no tokoro da' read as The O having gone to RX. #0.114 ends mid-block; #0.115 is in story_041.

report: 80/80 rows. Mostly party-leader variant rows (#0.35-52, #0.59-66, #0.85-114) given matching English. #0.71-72 compressed to fit the box. 'King Stone', 'Super Soldier', 'quantum brainwaves' not in glossary. #0.79 'Lord The O' for the honorific. Source spells Bound 'Dog' in #0.58-59; glossary 'Bound Doc' used.
